players.product: electric service and new transmission for large data-center loads (Kentucky Power: 1 GW contracted for TeraWulf's Muskie campus; Indiana Michigan Power: Google, Microsoft; SPP: Amazon)

connects_to.relationship: amended electric service agreement through Kentucky Power for TeraWulf's Muskie data campus (contracted demand doubled to 1 GW; 765-kV / 345-kV substation)

contracts.source: American Electric Power press release: Kentucky Power, TeraWulf Finalize Expanded Agreement (10-05-2026)
contracts.signal: Kentucky Power finalized an amended agreement that would double its contracted electric demand with TeraWulf at the Muskie Data campus in Grayson, Kentucky, from 500 megawatts (MW) to 1 gigawatt (GW), advancing the second 500-MW phase from 2030 to 2029; if approved by the Kentucky Public Service Commission it provides $100 million in winter bill credits funded by TeraWulf over the first 10 years, and TeraWulf pays the estimated financing costs of Kentucky Power's planned 760-MW combined-cycle facility at Big Sandy.
contracts.value: $100 million in winter bill credits funded by TeraWulf
